lessons: GET /slots?clinic=&date= returns [{start, end, practitionerId}]. It is paginated with ?cursor=, 50 slots per page.

options.kickoff: Ask Backend whether the slots endpoint is paginated and how. Then call wait until the answer arrives (answer any office questions that come to you meanwhile with reply). Write the answer to notes/backend.md.

lessons: The calendar needs ISO 8601 UTC timestamps plus the clinic's IANA time zone, and shows times in clinic local time. The Sydney clinic complained about raw UTC in v0.
